scope: 18 actionable scoring-integrity quarantines from the 2026-08-25 pre-change catalog

resolved.root_cause: Inositol hexanicotinate had no exact active-moiety conversion into the supplemental-niacin UL assessment.
resolved.correction: Use the exact compound-only factor (6 x 123.11) / 810.7 = 0.9111385222647094 mg NE per mg compound and assess the resulting exposure against the supplemental-niacin UL.

resolved.root_cause: A separately disclosed pyridoxal 5-phosphate row was treated as unrelated unresolved compound mass instead of a vitamin B6 vitamer.
resolved.correction: Include explicitly declared pyridoxal 5-phosphate in the vitamin B6 exposure assessed by the UL path.

resolved.root_cause: Label-active projections and synthetic product-level evidence rows were conflated, preventing otherwise complete mapped actives from satisfying readiness.
resolved.correction: Keep label-active projections matchable and exclude only synthetic product-level aggregates from material evidence readiness.

retained_missing_label_information.reason: The labels disclose an omega-3 total and name EPA/DHA without assigning amounts to the child actives. The total cannot be duplicated or allocated across children without label evidence.
The label discloses only a 60 mg proprietary blend total for olive oil and oregano oil, with no child allocation.
The material botanical children have no usable owned doses.
The source projection does not provide usable owned doses for the declared material actives.
The label provides a 1 mL proprietary blend with ten undosed botanical children; volume cannot be converted into per-ingredient mass or identity ownership.
The hierarchy contains non-scorable nested projections without enough source ownership to reconcile a complete scorable-active panel.

retained_policy_review.reason: PubChem resolves the exact label string to CID 112500385 (C20H32N2O), which is not mebolazine/dymethazine CID 66847280 (C42H68N2O2). A compound-specific banned-substance alias would be chemically false. FDA class-level bodybuilding guidance supports concern but does not establish the exact compound-specific US verdict required by the production contract.
No authoritative exact-identity record was verified for the label string. Similarity to a known steroid name is not sufficient to assign a compound-specific banned or controlled-substance verdict.
No authoritative exact-identity record was verified for the label string. Similarity to norethandrolone is not sufficient to assign a compound-specific banned or controlled-substance verdict.

acceptance_note: Retained products are closed as explicit, safe dispositions rather than unresolved engineering defects. Their catalog eligibility may change only when new source-label data or exact clinical-policy signoff is recorded.
